stemMarkdown: 27 workers, each working 11 hours a day, can complete a job in 16 days. How many days will 16 workers, each working 9 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 27 \times 16 \times 11$ worker-hours $= 4752$. With 16 workers at 9 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{4752}{16\times9} = 33.00$.
